answer: What keeps this honest is hackerspace membership proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 554 pays 7756 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One knoll of signal, one quartz of cost, one mesa of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
